name: Katsuragi Tomoe
source: Tomoe is one of Asumi's roommates. She's kind and responsible girl every schoolmate dreaming about. At the same time, she's terribly shy and lacks of self-confidence (especially when it comes to the boys). That's why she was forced to accept Asumi's dictatorship and became a good friend of hers.
